notes: three routes to the book, each with its own names and each ending at Abdullah b. al-Mughira: no shared tail; «رضي اللّه عنه» and «عنه» are blessings or back-references to the same route, not names
the opening «عن عبد اللّه بن المغيرة» names the book's source and is not a separate link; the Saduq's «محمد بن الحسن» and «محمد بن الحسن الصفار» are two men (rule 7)
